### EQ001 — Single-excitation Tavis-Cummings-Hubbard Hamiltonian

*model*

$$
H=\omega_a a^\dagger a+\varepsilon\sum_i\sigma_i^\dagger\sigma_i+\sum_i g(a^\dagger\sigma_i+\mathrm{h.c.})+\sum_i t_i(\sigma_i^\dagger\sigma_{i+1}+\mathrm{h.c.}),\quad t_i=t+\delta t X_i
$$

status: `verified` · source: equation: Main Eq. (1); tex_label: eq:H

Numerical form:

```
H[0,i]=H[i,0]=g; H[i,i+1]=H[i+1,i]=t_mean+delta_t*X[i]
```

Code: `src/cavity_transport/model.py::build_hamiltonian`


### EQ002 — Non-Condon emission, absorption, and detailed balance

*rate_model*

$$
\gamma_{em}=2J(\Delta)(1+n),\quad \gamma_{abs}=2J(\Delta)n,\quad \gamma_{abs}/\gamma_{em}=e^{-\Delta/(k_BT)}
$$

status: `verified` · source: equation: Main Eq. (2), SM Eq. (S4), SM Eq. (S17); tex_label: eq:rates

Numerical form:

```
gamma_abs = gamma_rec * exp(-1.0 / thermal_ratio), with zero at thermal_ratio=0
```

### EQ004 — Eigenstate rescue rate and photonic-weight sum rule

*central_observable*

$$
W^{rec}_{k\leftarrow l}=\gamma_{rec}w_k(1-w_l),\quad \sum_{k\in B}W^{rec}_{k\leftarrow l\in D}=\gamma_{rec}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001`, `EQ003` · source: equation: Main Eq. (4); tex_label: eq:rescue

Numerical form:

```

```
